title: Birthday Wisher
tech: React , Node, MongoDB, Express, JavaScript, Tailwind, API
desc: A birthday wisher app that allows users to create and manage birthday wishes for their loved ones. Users can add new wishes, view existing wishes, and receive notifications on the birthday of their friends and family members.

title: TrueRate
desc: TrueRate is a simple Currency Converter as a weekend side project. You can convert between multiple currencies and see clean, instant result.

title: Wonders of World
desc: This is a interactive “Wonders of the World” showcase that brings iconic landmarks to life using a cool slice animation effect. Each wonder animates in with motion and reveals a bit of its story — a small way to make learning visual and fun

title: NoteDesk
desc: Write, save, and organize your notes in one place. Pages Notes helps you stay focused and productive across all your apps.

title: Countly
desc: A custom countdown generator where you can create a personalized countdown page and share it as a link.

title: MatchGrid
desc: MatchGrid is a fast-paced memory game designed to test your focus, speed, and recall skills. Flip the cards, remember their positions, and find all matching emoji pairs before time runs out.

title: Reveal
desc: A webpage where an image is revealed only when you hover over it. Simple idea surprisingly satisfying result.

title: Snake & Ladder
desc: Snake & Ladder Game for Web  using React.

title: Galary
desc: Built a small experiment where an image is mapped onto a cylinder geometry and rotated, creating a circular image effect.

title: Photo Booth
desc: Built a small project using React — a web-based photo booth that: Captures photos from the camera, Lets users apply filters, Creates a collage OR saves a single photo, Allows downloading the final image.

title: Love Me?
desc: a tiny project called 'Do you love me?'. Two buttons:✔️ Yes ,❌ No. And as soon as you go near No……it sprints like Usain Bolt. Gone. Vanished. Teleported. 😂

title: Paint
desc: Played around with the canvas to build a simple online paint tool that works smoothly across screen sizes. Mostly just exploring how drawing, events, and responsiveness behave in the browser.
